author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before: an upright mitten with stubby bumps and a closed flat base, so it lost the reference's rightward lean and long fingers and read as a fist. After: three long 1:3-slanted fingers sharing walls with exact r5 tips, a 1:2 thumb pointing up-left with a notch at the index finger, and an open wrist; reads as a raised, leaning open hand at 48 in both themes.
omissions: Little finger and palm crease omitted: four slanted 9.5-wide fingers plus the thumb exceed the 40-unit width.
